operator_sequence: Confirm rear >=3m clear level area, firm suitable rear barrier, rear1m intervention mark, unloaded vehicle and X1/supply-cutoff access
CONTROL_READY: neutral CH6 once; MOTION_READY: reverse throttle only, steering centered; <=5rpm/<3s
STOP: neutral; actual standstill and anti-roll before OFF; record actual reverse displacement/stopping observations
capture: RK3588 candump plus independent JCAN 207F346D5650 receive/hardware ACK; no JCAN data sends
acceptance: Correct equal negative logical targets, abs<=5rpm, nonzero<3s
Actual rearward motion/normal stop, no unintended restart, full restoration and dual capture agreement
Total displacement<1m and post-stop distance<=0.5m; no barrier contact; measurement method recorded
failure: Preserve failures; X1 first, power cutoff if ineffective, barrier last resort; stationary and anti-roll before final OFF; no retry
next: Ground turning/differential only after review and a new trial
authorization: User authorized G5 ground reverse trial; fresh START confirms barrier, empty area and marked1m intervention line; <=5rpm/<3s
